race.comment: Talented filly BETTOR BEACH (4) stretched her winning streak to four when she led and dictated in her heat at this circuit and distance last week. She draws a couple of spots wider but she led from this barrier when she won a Vicbred Super Series heat before going on for a dominant win in the final last month. Has the early speed to go forward again so is the one to beat. Stablemate WILLOWS GIRL (2) is two for two here since a spell, coming from this barrier and using the sprint lane for a 5.7m win in last week's heat. Yet to miss a place when third-up so should be hitting her peak. Looks the main danger. Queensland Oaks winner RIPPLES NZ (6) and former Kiwi THE QUEENS GAMBIT NZ (7) cop wide draws but both are capable fillies who were solid when placed in last week's heats so are worth including along with PRE EMINANT (12) who may need some luck from the back row but is consistent.
